description:
Team,

Please find below the inventory for the upcoming BizTalk Server application deployment. The BizTalk reference assemblies to be installed are **BizTalk.Common.dll** located in **bins\BizTalk.Common.dll** and **BizTalk.Adapter.dll** in **bins\Adapters\BizTalk.Adapter.dll**. Additional reference assemblies required are **Utility.dll** (libs\Utility.dll) and **DataAccess.dll** (libs\DataAccess.dll). The binding configurations consist of **MainBindings.xml** (bindings\MainBindings.xml) and **OrchestrationBindings.xml** (bindings\OrchestrationBindings.xml). Pre‑processing will run the script **SetupEnv.vbs** (scripts\SetupEnv.vbs) with arguments *env,debug*, followed by **InitDB.ps1** (scripts\InitDB.ps1) using the argument *init*. Post‑processing will execute **Cleanup.vbs** (scripts\Cleanup.vbs) with arguments *temp,logs* and then **Notify.ps1** (scripts\Notify.ps1) with the argument *email*. Supporting documentation includes **Readme.txt** (docs\Readme.txt) and **License.md** (docs\License.md).

The deployment sequence is straightforward: first run **SetupEnv.vbs**, then deploy the **Utility.dll** assembly, apply the **MainBindings.xml** configuration, and finally execute the **Cleanup.vbs** script. Please confirm that all listed components are available in the specified locations before the deployment window.
